chcv_send_hint: Goes out on %1$s first, as “من كور هب (your name): …”, then to the agent, which answers there. The reply shows here when the agent finishes.
chcv_send_error_channel: %1$s refused the message, so it did not reach the agent: %2$s
chcv_send_status_posted: Posted on %1$s · waiting for the agent to take it
chcv_send_status_delivered: With the agent · it answers when its current turn ends
chcv_send_failed_bridge_no_answer: Posted on %1$s, but Hermes did not take it in time (its messaging gateway may be restarting). Sending again posts it on %1$s again.
chcv_send_failed_not_accepted: Posted on %1$s, but Hermes refused to hand it to the agent.
chcv_send_failed_not_picked_up: Posted on %1$s, but the agent never picked it up. Hermes’s log says why.
chcv_send_unavailable_not_admin: A conversation from %1$s. Only an admin can write into it from here; replies are made in %1$s.
chcv_send_unavailable_platform_unsupport: A conversation from %1$s — read-only here for now. Writing from Core Hub works for Telegram and WhatsApp.
chcv_send_unavailable_hermes_not_managed: A conversation from %1$s — read-only: this hub does not run Hermes, so it cannot write into it.
chcv_send_unavailable_bridge_offline: A conversation from %1$s — writing from here is unavailable while Hermes’s messaging gateway is starting or stopped.
chcv_send_unavailable_not_current: This %1$s chat has moved on to a newer conversation; a message from here would go there.
chcv_send_unavailable_no_route: A conversation from %1$s — Hermes keeps no way back to this chat, so it cannot be written into from here.
